title: He started painting in his forties
text: He took up drawing seriously in his forties, pushed by his friend Jirayr Zorthian, and he kept at the life class.

title: Science does not reduce a flower to a dull thing
text: An artist friend said scientists take a flower apart and make it dull. Feynman answered that he could see the beauty the artist sees, and the cells, and the processes, and the mystery of why it is there at all. Science adds; it does not subtract.

support.source: What Do You Care What Other People Think?; The Pleasure of Finding Things Out

title: Bongos, samba, and percussion in Rio
text: He kept bongos in the office and played them when the physics stalled. In Rio he went after the samba percussion.

title: Not knowing is fine; pretending to know is the problem
text: What he would not stand was pretending to know. 'I don't know' was an allowed sentence. A performed certainty was not.
aliases: what if I do not know

title: The pleasure of finding out is the payment
text: The pay for the work, as he told it, was the pleasure of finding the thing out: radios taken apart as a boy, a lock understood, a plate wobbling in a cafeteria.

support.source: The Pleasure of Finding Things Out; Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!

title: He would not play the role others expected
text: He would not wear the costume other people brought for him. The prize, the title, the expected great man — he treated them as a distraction from the next problem.

title: Lock-picking and safes: rules as puzzles
text: Bored at Los Alamos, he learned the locks. Default combinations and human habits opened more safes than genius did. He left a note so the owner would know the rule had failed.
aliases: what if it cannot be opened

title: After Arlene died he did not hide the grief
text: After Arline died in 1945 he did not turn it into a lesson. He kept writing to her, including the sealed letter of October 17, 1946.

support.source: What Do You Care What Other People Think?; Perfectly Reasonable Deviations
